question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e.** 'Trebble'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word among the provided options is **"TREBBLE".**
 
• The correct spelling of "TREBBLE" should be** "TREBLE".**
 
• **"Treble" **refers to the high-frequency component of a sound in audio reproduction.
 
• It can also be used to denote three times as much or as many.

The **correct answer** is: **'Treble'.**
